en: Black-and-white postcard showing a richly decorated baroque altar inside a church. The altar features marble-like columns, ornate carvings, religious paintings, and statues of saints on either side. A cloth-covered altar table with candlesticks stands at the front. The caption in Hungarian is printed along the bottom margin of the image. The reverse side is blank except for standard postcard dividing lines and small printed Hungarian text, plus a handwritten date.
